invoice-fields: SELECT TRIM(RDB$FIELD_NAME) AS FIELD_NAME FROM RDB$RELATION_FIELDS WHERE RDB$RELATION_NAME='FACTF15' ORDER BY RDB$FIELD_POSITION
client-balance: SELECT CLAVE,NOMBRE,SALDO FROM CLIE15 WHERE TRIM(CLAVE)='2035'
installment-tables: SELECT TRIM(RDB$RELATION_NAME) AS TABLE_NAME FROM RDB$RELATIONS WHERE RDB$SYSTEM_FLAG=0 AND (RDB$RELATION_NAME CONTAINING 'PLAZ' OR RDB$RELATION_NAME CONTAINING 'PAGO' OR RDB$RELATION_NAME CONTAINING 'COND' OR RDB$RELATION_NAME CONTAINING 'FINAN')
roots: SELECT M.CVE_CLIE,M.REFER,M.NUM_CARGO,M.NUM_CPTO,C.DESCR,M.NO_FACTURA,M.IMPORTE,M.SIGNO,M.FECHA_APLI,M.FECHA_VENC,M.STATUS FROM CUEN_M15 M LEFT JOIN CONC15 C ON C.NUM_CPTO=M.NUM_CPTO WHERE M.NO_FACTURA='F-EQ000082' OR M.REFER='F-EQ000082' ORDER BY M.CVE_CLIE,M.NUM_CARGO
all-client-applications: SELECT D.CVE_CLIE,D.REFER,D.NUM_CARGO,D.NUM_CPTO,C.DESCR,D.NO_FACTURA,D.DOCTO,D.IMPORTE,D.SIGNO,D.FECHA_APLI,D.FECHA_VENC,D.ID_MOV,D.NO_PARTIDA FROM CUEN_DET15 D LEFT JOIN CONC15 C ON C.NUM_CPTO=D.NUM_CPTO WHERE TRIM(D.CVE_CLIE)='2035' ORDER BY D.FECHA_APLI,D.NUM_CARGO
